exposure: combined spinal-epidural (CSE) analgesia using 0.2% Ropivacaine 4mg and Fentanyl 25microg during labour
outcome: duration of first stage of labour
duration of second stage of labour
cohort: The study included 60 nullipara patients with singleton pregnancy, term gestation, cephalic presentation, scheduled for normal vaginal delivery, who received combined spinal-epidural analgesia at 3-5cm cervical dilatation.
finding: CSE analgesia using ropivacaine and fentanyl resulted in normal vaginal deliveries for 83.3% of patients, excellent patient satisfaction in 96.67%, and no babies with an Apgar score <7.
mod_finding: The study found that 83.3% of patients had normal vaginal deliveries, 3.3% had instrumental deliveries, and 13.3% underwent caesarean section.
